title: Read document attachments
summary: List or read document attachments and copy them into source with permission.
purpose: List or read document attachments and copy them into source with permission.
request: Use {{route:attachments.document.list}}, {{route:attachments.document.read}}, or {{route:attachments.document.copy}}. For a copy, supply `target_path` relative to the caller’s worktree.
response: The list shows document attachments. Source tools can find files after copying.
errors: On a permission error, check the token’s attachment capability. Copying requires `read_write`.
